H03-02: Inspection of dialogs, modals, and popups for a visible close control.
Pass: Every modal/dialog contains a detectable close button.
Fail: A modal/dialog exists without any identifiable close button or dismissal action.
2. Search for common close controls (e.g., .close-button, data-dismiss).
3. If no quick match, scan buttons/links for aria-label, title, or text containing "close" or "×".
If a dialog, modal, or popup lacks a visible close button:
- Add a clearly labeled close button (e.g., an aria-label="Close" button) to allow users to easily dismiss the dialog.
